title: Girl Sitting in Sunny Lawn Garden, 1950s B&W Snapshot Photo
description: A mid-1950s candid black-and-white snapshot featuring a young girl or woman sitting on a grassy lawn beside a flower garden in front of a suburban home. The image features deckled edges and an unintentional double exposure effect or camera light bleed pattern running across the composition. The reverse side features a stamped processing code 963B.
